body.name: Middle-residual shear
body.construction: For a mechanism \(m\) and \((t_0,u_0)\) near \((0,0)\), set \(A_m(t_0,u_0)=\begin{pmatrix}1&0&0\\t_0&1+a(m)t_0+d(m)u_0&u_0\\0&0&1\end{pmatrix}\), \(\varepsilon'_{m,t_0,u_0}:=A_m(t_0,u_0)\varepsilon\), \(\nu'_{m,t_0,u_0}:=A_m(t_0,u_0)_{\#}\mathcal L_m(\varepsilon)=\mathcal L_m(\varepsilon'_{m,t_0,u_0})\), and \(K'_{m,t_0,u_0}:=A_m(t_0,u_0)K_m\). Then \(K'_{m,t_0,u_0}=\begin{pmatrix}1&-a(m)&0\\-b'_{m,t_0,u_0}&1&-c'_{m,t_0,u_0}\\0&-d(m)&1\end{pmatrix}\), where \(b'_{m,t_0,u_0}=b(m)(1+a(m)t_0+d(m)u_0)-t_0\) and \(c'_{m,t_0,u_0}=c(m)(1+a(m)t_0+d(m)u_0)-u_0\), and define \(m'_{t_0,u_0}:=(a(m),b'_{m,t_0,u_0},c'_{m,t_0,u_0},d(m),\nu'_{m,t_0,u_0})\). The defining structural algebra is \(K'_{m,t_0,u_0}X=A_m(t_0,u_0)K_mX=A_m(t_0,u_0)\varepsilon=\varepsilon'_{m,t_0,u_0}\).
